author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices counting in threes, finger order, steps and skips, and remembering words in order, with the first day of an old memory song.

classes.title: Find your five-finger house
classes.goal: Find C by its landmark and rest one finger on each key from C to G.

mathTarget.parentLine: Using the two black keys to find where the hand lives

classes.parentPrompt: Point to the two black keys, then help your child rest the thumb on C, just left.
classes.childAction: Thumb on C, then one finger on each key up to G.
classes.bridge: Two black keys are a roof; C is the door just left of it.

intro.caption: Find the two black keys
intro.parentCue: help the thumb land just left of them, on C

games.caption: One finger, one key
games.parentCue: Say the finger numbers, one to five

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding the hand's place by a landmark.

classes.title: Three, then three more
classes.goal: Play 'On the first day': the grown-up plays three low Gs, the child answers with three Cs.

mathTarget.parentLine: Seeing and hearing three at a glance

classes.parentPrompt: You play the three low Gs; hold up three fingers, then let your child play three Cs.
classes.childAction: Count to three as you play C, C, C after your grown-up.
classes.bridge: Three low Gs knock on the left; three Cs answer from the house.

intro.caption: Three for me, three for you
intro.parentCue: you play the three low Gs first

games.caption: Your three: C, C, C
games.parentCue: Hold up three fingers and count together

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: counting and playing groups of three.

classes.title: Up the stairs: 1, 2, 3, 4
classes.goal: Play 'my true love gave to me': fingers climb 1, 2, 3, 4, then step back.

mathTarget.parentLine: Fingers in order: first, second, third, fourth

classes.parentPrompt: Say the finger numbers out loud and touch each finger gently before it plays.
classes.childAction: Play fingers 1, 2, 3, 4 up the stairs, then step back.
classes.bridge: Each finger is a stair: first, second, third, fourth, then a little step back.

intro.caption: First, second, third, fourth
intro.parentCue: touch each finger before it plays

games.caption: My true love gave to me

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing fingers in order, one to four.

classes.title: Your notes, my notes
classes.goal: Play the whole song slowly; the grown-up plays the notes outside the child's hand.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two jobs fit together to make one tune

classes.parentPrompt: Play the low Gs, the B and the high A; sing the next word if needed.
classes.childAction: Play the notes in your house; let your grown-up play the rest.
classes.bridge: Your hand stays home; the grown-up visits the keys outside the house.

intro.caption: Your notes, my notes
intro.parentCue: you play every note outside your child's hand

games.caption: Tap the beat: the first line
games.parentCue: Play the blue keys; your child taps the beat

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: fitting two parts together in one song.

classes.title: Steps and skips
classes.goal: Play 'in a pear tree' slowly and feel next-door steps and little skips.

mathTarget.parentLine: Next-door keys, or jumping over one

classes.parentPrompt: Touch the skipped key with your finger so your child sees the little jump.
classes.childAction: Play F, E, skip down to C, then D, C.
classes.bridge: A step is next door; a skip hops over one key, like a partridge hop.

intro.caption: Step next door, or skip one?
intro.parentCue: touch the key that gets skipped

games.caption: In a pear tree, slowly
games.parentCue: Point to the skipped D before the skip

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: telling steps and skips apart.

classes.title: Four beats, slow and even
classes.goal: Play the whole song slowly while counting four beats in every bar.

mathTarget.parentLine: Each bar holds four even beats

classes.parentPrompt: Tap your child's shoulder on each beat, count 1, 2, 3, 4. You play the outside notes.
classes.childAction: Play slowly while your grown-up counts to four.
classes.bridge: Each bar is a little gift box with four beats inside.

intro.caption: Slow and even is best
intro.parentCue: tap your child's shoulder and count to four

games.caption: Tap and count to four
games.parentCue: Count softly as your child taps

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing slowly and evenly in fours.

classes.title: Same song, up the tree
classes.goal: Play the same song with the same fingers on a higher C.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same pattern moved to a new place sounds higher

classes.parentPrompt: Show your child the next two black keys to the right; help the thumb find that C.
classes.childAction: Move your hand up to the next C and play again.
classes.bridge: Higher C is the same house, high up in the pear tree.

intro.caption: Same song, higher up
intro.parentCue: ask your child: which one sounds nicer?

games.caption: Up high: my true love
games.parentCue: Help the thumb find the higher C

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing the same song in a new place.

classes.title: Keep up with the music
classes.goal: Play the whole song along with the music at full speed.

mathTarget.parentLine: Keeping up with a beat that does not wait

classes.parentPrompt: Nod on each beat and play the outside notes; if a note slips, keep going.
classes.childAction: Play along with the music and keep going, even after a slip.
classes.bridge: The music is a moving sleigh; hop on and ride, even past bumps.

intro.caption: Hop on and keep going
intro.parentCue: nod the beat and smile at slips

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping up with the music together.

classes.title: Sing it, remember it
classes.goal: Sing the words while playing, then remember what the first gift was.

mathTarget.parentLine: Remembering words in order, like the old game

classes.parentPrompt: Sing along while your child plays; afterwards ask: what was the gift on day one?
classes.childAction: Sing and play, then tell your grown-up the first gift.
classes.bridge: Long ago this was a memory game: each player remembered the gifts in order.

intro.caption: Sing it, then remember it
intro.parentCue: sing first; it is fine if singing comes and goes

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: singing, playing and remembering words in order.

classes.title: Partridge concert for teddy
classes.goal: Play the whole song for teddy, hold the long last C, then bow.

mathTarget.parentLine: The tune ends by landing on its home note

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy as the audience; announce the song, hold the last note together, then bow.
classes.childAction: Play for teddy, hold the last C long, then take a bow.
classes.bridge: The partridge flies, then settles home on C for a long, long rest.

intro.caption: Concert time for teddy!
intro.parentCue: put teddy in front as the audience

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole song, start to end.
